BACKEND (8/8 pytest, pytest_cook_mode_perf.xml): (A) POST /api/mobile-voice/tts returns /api/audio/file/*.mp3 URL, is disk-cached (2nd identical call <5s, same filename), returns 3 unique URLs for 3 unique step texts, empty text -> 400, audio file is actually served with audio/mpeg content-type. (B) POST /api/recipes/detailed first call returns 200 with {recipe:<markdown>, cached:false}, 2nd call same title returns {cached:true} in <3s and same content — proves the gpt-4o-mini + DB cache works. Numbered '1. ...' steps present (>=3) in the markdown so parseSteps() in cook.tsx has real steps. POST /api/recipes/discover returns Unsplash CDN images_urls, never /recipe-image/ai-generate. FRONTEND (Playwright, mobile 390x844): registered fresh user, did the RC Test Store purchase flow (paywall-subscribe -> confirm-buy -> 'Test valid purchase' -> premium-active visible, 'You\'re a Premium member. Enjoy!' toast), navigated to /recipe via the same providedContent path used by 'View full recipe' (URL param `content=<markdown with 5 numbered steps>`), verified: (i) recipe hero image renders, save-detail + cook-mode buttons present; (ii) ZERO POST /api/recipes/detailed fired while opening /recipe (proves providedContent short-circuit). Tapped cook-mode -> /cook loads, header shows 'Step 1 of 5' (NOT 'Step 5 of 5' — key regression verified). Tapping cook-next once -> 'Step 2 of 5'; twice -> 'Step 3 of 5' (single-step increments, never skips to end). Tapping cook-prev -> back to 'Step 2 of 5'. toggle-autoadvance toggles cleanly (verified checkbox flips off, no auto-advance cascade fires). POST /api/mobile-voice/tts observed exactly 3 times (one per unique step visited 1,2,3). Perf regression check: on the Discover home flow after landing/tapping a mood, ZERO /api/recipe-image/ai-generate POSTs were fired — confirms per-card AI image generation is fully removed from list rendering. AI image is only requested on /recipe DETAIL for premium users (1 call observed there, as intended by the fix). No React Native red screens; only benign warnings ('shadow*' deprecated, useNativeDriver on web, props.pointerEvents deprecated).
critical_code_review_comments: cook.tsx:54 sets wasFinishedRef.current = true BEFORE player.replace()/player.play() for a new step. Combined with the false->true edge check at cook.tsx:71-77, this correctly suppresses the stale didJustFinish from the previous step's audio, so the counter can never cascade from 1 to N. Verified in headless: 1 -> 2 -> 3 (single-step) with tts called once per step.

recipe.tsx:53-65 detailed useQuery has `enabled: !providedContent` — Playwright network trace confirms 0 /api/recipes/detailed POSTs when content param is present. This is the perf win for the Text import / Fridge instant-render paths.

recipes.py:104-171 detailed endpoint switched to gpt-4o-mini (line 139) with a title_lower cache key. Backend test measured cached call at <1s vs generation ~4-10s. Regression: cached response returns EXACT same recipe text on 2nd call.

RecipeCard.tsx:85-95 uses recipe.image_url || foodImage(...) — no useRecipeImage() call is invoked at card render, so no /recipe-image/ai-generate POST fires from the list. Verified with 0 hits during landing + Discover flow. useRecipeImage is still exported and consumed only by recipe.tsx (detail screen, premium-gated).

cook.tsx:34/54 uses a single ref wasFinishedRef with a defensive initial value = true. Nit: the value is essentially a 'skip the very first spurious event' flag; a boolean would work but the true/false edge semantics are correct as commented. No functional issue.

rca_of_issue: Both fixes reviewed are working. (A) The prior cascade-to-last bug was because setIndex was being re-fired on every render where status?.didJustFinish stayed true (stale after step-1 finished, then step-2 started with a not-yet-updated status). The current code (cook.tsx:37-77) does two things: (i) wasFinishedRef is set to true BEFORE player.replace() every time a step is (re)loaded, so the didJustFinish==true carried in from the last step is treated as an 'already handled' state and cannot trigger another setIndex; (ii) the auto-advance effect only fires on the FALSE->TRUE edge (finished && !wasFinishedRef.current). Together these guarantee exactly one auto-advance per unique audio-finished event, and manual cook-next/cook-prev increments by ±1. (B) recipes.py:139 was gpt-4o -> now gpt-4o-mini with the same DB cache; RecipeCard.tsx no longer calls useRecipeImage() at render time so no /recipe-image/ai-generate is fired for cards; recipe.tsx still calls useRecipeImage but only for premium users AND only when no providedImg is supplied — matches the spec 'AI photo only on the recipe DETAIL screen and only for premium'.
